name: SETIC government data center (national hosting)
developer: SETIC (Executive Secretariat for ICT, Government of Burundi)
notes: Iwacu (May 2021): SETIC is the specialized government body managing a data center and hosting the sites/data of state institutions. SETIC/PAFEN mid-term page names national hosting through a Data Center and government network modernization. Facility site not named; Bujumbura (legacy Bujumbura Mairie, current Bujumbura province) is the government/telecom cluster. A upgrade requires a SETIC primary source naming the facility.

name: Burundi Backbone System (BBS) server/web hosting
notes: BBS official site lists Hebergement Web and Hebergement Serveur with pricing (e.g., server hosting 3,000,000 BIF/12 months) - A for marketed service. Directories place a BBS datacenter at 20 Boulevard Mwambutsa, Quartier Kigobe, Bujumbura (C-grade facility detail; racks/address/power not confirmed by BBS itself).

name: Buja Online data center / VPS hosting
notes: Official site describes a local Bujumbura data center offering VPS, web hosting, fiber internet and IT hardware services; datacenters.com corroborates a Bujumbura facility. Small local hoster; capacity not public.

name: Lumitel (Viettel Burundi) cloud server service
notes: Official Lumitel page exposes a Cloud server service surface with Bujumbura address context. A for marketed cloud service; physical local datacenter infrastructure unproven until operator/tender evidence names a site.

name: Central Bank of Burundi (BRB) main data centre modernization
developer: Banque de la Republique du Burundi / BAIP group / NRD
notes: BAIP/INVL reported completion of BRB critical IT infrastructure and data migration covering the main data centre at the Central Bank head office in Bujumbura (plus Ngozi DR and Gitega branch infrastructure). Institutional/bank facility; capacity not public.

name: PAFEN national physical data hosting solution (data center)
developer: Government of Burundi / SETIC / World Bank (IDA)
notes: World Bank PAFEN (IDA USD 92M) project documents include preparation of specifications for a new physical data hosting solution (a data center); finance ministry 2026-03-23 mid-term review names a national data center as priority; SETIC/PAFEN AMI for data-hosting study (2024) shows procurement path. Exact site not public; assigned to Bujumbura Mairie (central government cluster). May overlap with CDIN (see de-dup note there).

name: Ministry of Health national data center roadmap
developer: Ministry of Public Health and Fight Against AIDS / Government of Burundi
notes: World Bank DE4A Burundi assessment: PNDIS II health informatics plan includes establishment of a data center within the Ministry of Health. Institutional planned facility; exact ministry site/capacity not stated.

name: CDIN - Centre de Donnees Integre National
notes: PDDSP 2023-2033 derived national integrated data centre project; A for plan, not facility - remains planned until official tender/award/EIES/construction names a site. Location unknown per official sources (Bujumbura or Gitega possible; assigned here to Bujumbura Mairie as central government cluster working assumption). Keep separate from SETIC/PAFEN national hosting until sources prove a common site.

name: Econet Leo core/NOC data-centre engineering (lead)
notes: Econet Leo (ARCT-confirmed mobile operator) runs a Network Operations Center in Burundi (NOC surveillance engineer vacancy, esoko.bi). Group-level Cassava Technologies includes data centers, but no named Burundi colocation facility. Telco core/NOC lead only; not counted as a commercial DC.

name: CNI / NIC.BI registry infrastructure
notes: .bi domain registry and legacy computing institution; registry/hosting infrastructure likely in Bujumbura but no primary page names server/hosting infrastructure or location. B/C lead per methodology.

name: Lacell SU / Smart Burundi data center
notes: Directories list a Bujumbura facility (Boulevard de l'Independance) operated by Lacell SU / Smart Burundi. Status unknown: Smart's telecom operation was shut down in 2022 per public records while facility directories still list the site. C-grade directory evidence only.

name: CIU - Universite Polytechnique de Gitega computing centre (PAFEN)
developer: PAFEN / Government of Burundi / World Bank (IDA)
notes: PAFEN tender includes equipment acquisition for five university computing centres (CIU), one at Universite Polytechnique de Gitega; Iwacu confirms CIU deployment underway under PAFEN broadband programme. Institutional compute room (university), not commercial colocation; procurement/deployment lead.

name: Central Bank of Burundi Gitega branch IT infrastructure
developer: Banque de la Republique du Burundi / BAIP group / NRD
notes: BRB data centre modernization covered three sites including a Gitega branch (political capital). Source does not identify this branch as the DR site; capacity not public. Institutional bank facility.

name: Bank of the Republic of Burundi (BRB) disaster recovery center - Ngozi branch
developer: BAIP / NRD Companies for Bank of the Republic of Burundi
notes: BAIP/NRD contracts modernized BRB headquarters data centre infrastructure and created a disaster recovery center at the Ngozi branch. Institutional bank DR facility; no public MW. Other Ngozi searches (data center, centre de donnees, serveurs) returned only telecom coverage/ISP IP-range leads (e.g., CBINET), no additional DCs.
